She placed the page in the keeper’s log beside older storms and quieter rescues, wondering whether the bottle had reached its intended shore after all.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市浸在深蓝的寂静里。高楼窗灯稀疏，像未散尽的星子；街道空旷，环卫车缓缓驶过，水声掠过柏油路面。便利店透出暖黄灯光，有人趴在收银台旁打盹。远处高架桥上，首班公交拖着微弱轰鸣，把夜色掀开一道细缝。风带着露水和铁锈的气味，穿过楼宇。早餐铺蒸笼冒起白汽，闹钟还未响起，许多梦仍在继续，城市已轻轻醒转。","w03":"- Recursion is when a problem solves a smaller copy of itself.\n- Each step keeps calling the same idea with a simpler input until it reaches an easy base case.\n- When the base case answers, the smaller answers pass back up and combine into the final answer."}
